These rejections are respectfully traversed in view of the foregoing amendments and for at least the following reasons, and favorable reconsideration and allowance of the pending claims are therefore respectfully requested.
Amended claim 1 now calls for:
1. (Currently Amended) A method of determining the position of one or more components of a landing gear assembly of an aircraft, the method comprising the steps of:

scanning the one or more components of the landing gear assembly with a lidar system to generate a set of position data points, wherein each position data point comprises a set of three orthogonal position values;

partitioning the set of position data points into one or more clusters, wherein two position data points are determined to be in the same cluster if a distance metric for the two position data points is below a threshold;
determining, for each cluster of the one or more of the clusters, a component of the one or more components of the landing gear assembly that the cluster represents; and

determining, for each component of the one or more of the components of the landing gear assembly, the position of the component from the position data points in the cluster representing the component;

wherein the value of the distance metric for a first position data point and a second position data point is representative ofdetermined based solely on the difference between a first horizontal position value of the three orthogonal position values of the first position data point and the correspondingfirs SVG {EMBED HERE} 0.291.223 n value of the three orthogonalpos second position data point, wherein the horizontal position value of a position data point is indicative of a position along a line perpendicular to the plane through which the landing gear wheels of the landing gear assembly move when the landing gear assembly is extended, and

p.u: wherein the positions of the one or more components of the landin

gear assembly of the aircraft are tracked using the lidar system during the physical movement of the landing gear assembly as the landing gear assembly moves from the retracted position to the extended position or from the extended position to the retracted position.

body.p: The above amendments to claim 1 were finalized during the interview as overcoming the obviousness rejection using the combination of Shapoury, Jeong, and Liu. More specifically, it was agreed that neither Jeong nor Liu teaches or discloses the value of the distance metric for a first position data point and a second position data point is determined based solely on the difference between a horizontal position value of the three orthogonal position values of the first position data point and the corresponding horizontal position value of the three orthogonal position values of the second position data point, and that the horizontal position value of a position data point is indicative of a position along a line perpendicular to the plane throuigh which the landin g gear wheels of the landin g gear assembly move when the landing gear assembly is extended. Therefore, in view of the foregoing and in reliance on the agreement reached during the interview, Applicant respectfully requests that the Section 103 obviousness rejection of claim 1 be withdrawn.

Moreover, as also discussed and agreed during the interview, the amendments to claim 1 reciting "wherein the positions of the one or more components of the landing gear assembly of the aircraft are tracked using the lidar system during the physical movement of the landing gear assembly as the landing gear assembly moves from the retracted position to the extended position or from the extended position to the retracted position" would overcome the Section 101 rejection, and would render claim 1 patent eligible. Therefore, the Section 101 rejection of independent claim 1 is respectfully requested to be withdrawn.
Furthermore, independent claims 15 and 16 have been amended in a similar manner as claim 1, reciting, among other features:

... wherein the value of the distance metric for a first position data point and a second position data point is representative of determined based solely on the difference between a first horizontal position value of the three orthogonal position values of the first position data point and the corresponding first horizontal position value of the three orthogonal position values of the second position data point, wherein the horizontal position value of a position data point is indicative of a position along a line perpendicular to the plane through which the landing gear wheels of the landing gear assembly move when the landing gear assembly is extended, and

p.u: wherein the positions of the one or more components of the landing gear assembly of the aircraft are tracked using the lidar system during the physical movement of the landing gear assembly as the landing gear assembly moves from the retracted position to the extended position or from the extended position to the retracted position.

body.p: Therefore, Applicant respectfully submits that independent claims 15 and 16 are also patentable over the prior art combination, and the Section 103 obviousness rejections of claims 15 and 16, together with their Section 101 rejections are respectfully requested to be withdrawn.

Claims 2, 3, and 5-14 depend from claim 1, recite additional features and distinguish over the applied references for at least the reasons set forth above with respect to claim 1 and/or for the additional features recited.
The Applicant has made a diligent effort to place the claims in condition for
allowance, and respectfully submits that the application is now in condition for allowance, and an early notice to that effect is earnestly solicited.
